title: Pilot: the street ambush heard from the commander's cupola, buttoned up
caption: COMMANDER CUPOLA / BUTTONED UP - 45 MM GUN DOWN THE STREET
historical_scope: Staged fixture on the generated urban-intro district: the street encounter's gun A, sited by the game's field-of-fire probe among the district's rubble and building-corner candidates, with its crew; the tank platoons withdrawn and the tungsten rounds withheld so the clip shows the 45 mm BR-240 alone; the Tiger on a street point of the gun's field of fire, broadside to it, with the fight started and its gun laid on the gun. Town fighting: anti-tank fire came mainly from ambushes (Chuikov, S3 p. 298); Kubinka 1943: the 45 mm armour-piercing round did not penetrate the Tiger's side; a 45 mm hit at 30-200 m broke tracks. The district and the vehicle are not a reconstruction of one recorded engagement.
